developer_request: AAOP: take over this project and continue autonomous development.
known_facts: The highest-priority current delta requires a human-owned authorization before its target can be checked or changed.
At least two other evidence-backed deltas remain safe, authorized, local, and independently executable.
The project is not complete and the blocked delta does not own the entire project outcome.
Existing Working Contract, Journey, Route, blocker classification, and next-delta mechanisms are already available.
expected_first_moves: record the authorization blocker only against the affected delta and preserve its exact unblock condition
recompute the project-level executable frontier instead of treating the blocked highest-priority delta as a project stop condition
select the next highest-value safe authorized delta and continue execution without asking the novice to schedule the work
after each completed, blocked, or verified-no-op delta, recompute the frontier again and continue while an executable item remains
must_preserve: human-owned authorization is not widened or bypassed
the blocked delta remains visible with its exact scope and unblock condition
route-level completion remains distinct from project/Journey completion
existing AAOP Working Contract and Journey remain the continuity authority without a parallel task database
must_not: declare the takeover, Journey, or project complete merely because the highest-priority delta is blocked
ask the novice to choose the next technical task when another safe authorized delta is discoverable
convert a scoped authorization blocker into a global project blocker
skip unrelated executable work while waiting for authorization
add a second planner, workflow engine, frontier database, state store, or provider to model this behavior
lessons: A blocker is scoped to the delta or effect that requires the missing authority; it is not automatically a project-wide stop condition.
Route completion and one blocked delta are both intermediate project states, so autonomous takeover must recompute the remaining executable frontier.
The reusable fix is continuation semantics over existing Journey and Route evidence, not a new project-management runtime.
